messages:
Jules (devex): Heads-up: discovered a parity bug between REST and the Go SDK for the search endpoint. REST accepts nested `filters` as objects; Go SDK currently sends them stringified which yields 400s.
Naveen (sdk): Oof. Which SDK version and minimal repro?
Jules (devex): SDK v0.6.4. Repro: curl body with filters object works; Go SDK prints body with "filters": "{"tenant":"acct-A"}". Server rejects it.
Marta (qa): I can add a small integration asserting raw request body equals expected JSON for search/embeddings. Will run against staging.
Naveen (sdk): That stringification was a legacy rule for metadata fields in other endpoints. Looks like a serializer whitelist went too broad. I'll open a PR to tighten rules and add parity tests.
Jules (devex): Also saw the Go SDK set `Authorization: Token <val>` in one path while curl uses `Bearer`. Gateway rejects `Token`.
Naveen (sdk): Two fixes then: (1) remove stringification of `filters`/`meta` for user-facing endpoints, (2) normalize auth header to `Bearer` everywhere.
ci-bot: created branch sdk/go/fix-serial-auth-591 and triggered CI.
Naveen (sdk): Will target a patch release once CI passes. I'll also add a tiny smoke test in sample-apps quickstart to catch this in future.
Jules (devex): Please ping me when the patch is out so I can update the quickstart and onboarding note.
Marta (qa): Tests added to `sdk-parity` pipeline.
Naveen (sdk): PR merged, release v0.6.5 published with changelog: fix(serialization, auth): preserve nested objects for filters/meta; use Authorization: Bearer consistently; add parity tests.
Jules (devex): Verified quickstart works with v0.6.5. Closing loop.
